categories.name: Enriched Datasets
categories.description: Start here. These datasets have been parsed, annotated, and structured for analysis — queryable via BigQuery or downloadable as pre-computed summaries. Most research questions can be answered without touching raw data.

categories.name: Raw Datasets
categories.description: Unprocessed measurement logs and archives as collected directly from M-Lab's infrastructure, stored in Google Cloud Storage. Use these when enriched datasets don't cover your specific analysis need.
